description: A reserve product met by a group of individual reserves. The group requirement is additional to each member's own; a device contributing to a member reserve also counts toward the group. Membership is carried by ServiceAssociation rows.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

requirement.description: The value of required reserves. Units: MW.

variable.description: Operating reserve demand curve for the group, static or time-series-backed. A curve makes the group elastic, priced rather than enforced. Omit if none.

reserve_direction.description: Whether the reserve is an upward, downward, or symmetric reserve product.

title: GroupReserve
